paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the evaluation of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the dataset and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, in that order, with no apparent sorting or grouping. The vertical axis represents the score as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at regular intervals of 10. The chart features two sets of bars, one for each model, colored blue for LLaMA-3-8B-it and orange for Ours (Iterative RLHF). The GSM-8K benchmark has the tallest bars, reaching approximately 78 for both models, while the Chat-Arena-Hard benchmark has the shortest bars, at around 23 for LLaMA-3-8B-it and 30 for Ours (Iterative RLHF). Representative values for the models across benchmarks show scores ranging from 23 to 78 for LLaMA-3-8B-it and 30 to 78 for Ours (Iterative RLHF).
